mapper.update: UPDATE user u INNER JOIN `order` o ON o.user_name = u.username SET u.balance = u.balance - o.total_amount WHERE u.username = #{userName} AND o.order_no = #{orderNo} AND u.status = 1 AND u.balance >= o.total_amount
UPDATE user SET role = #{role}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{userId}
